_comment: A4 baseline pin. Hashes are EOL-NORMALISED (see row_baseline.py header). The gate blocks ONLY on a baselined row vanishing with no retirement entry.

legacy_unrowed._why: Seams that predate the store are GRANDFATHERED: listed, never fatal. A gate that demanded a row for every pre-existing seam would fail every build until the estate was fully rowed, and would be switched off.
legacy_unrowed.note: not yet enumerated — grandfathering is open by default
